create_OutputHandler: create an OutputHandler instance to manage benchmark result CSV and feather files
query_OutputHandler: query the OutputHandler for benchmark results filtered by model, benchmark, and task name
save_csv_OutputHandler: save local benchmark results to a feather file under a model and benchmark directory
save_aggregate_results_OutputHandler: save aggregate benchmark correctness scores to a shared feather file with locking
print_dataframe_OutputHandler: print a pivoted dataframe of model correctness scores grouped by benchmark type
